name: Mind as forerunner of things (manopubbaṅgamā dhammā)

definitions.definition: The opening of the Dhammapada: things (dhammā) have mind (mano) as forerunner, as chief, and are made of mind; what one says or does from a corrupted or a serene mind is followed by suffering or by happiness, as the wheel follows the foot of the ox or the shadow its owner (Dhp 1-2).
